## Querying a DataFrame with SQL

```{python}
import duckdb
import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "species": ["adelie", "gentoo", "chinstrap", "adelie", "gentoo"],
    "bill_mm": [38.8, 47.5, 48.8, 39.2, 46.1],
})
avg_bills = duckdb.sql(
    "SELECT species, avg(bill_mm) AS avg_bill FROM df GROUP BY species ORDER BY avg_bill"
).pl()
avg_bills
```

::: {.callout-note}
DuckDB queries polars DataFrames in place — no copies, no serialization.
:::

## A figure

```{python}
#| label: fig-bills
#| fig-cap: "Bill length by species (toy data)."
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3))
ax.bar(avg_bills["species"], avg_bills["avg_bill"])
ax.set_ylabel("avg bill length (mm)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

As @fig-bills shows, the pipeline renders matplotlib output with captions.
